title: Feature request: Allow creating notification/warning when Canula (or any other thing) has been in use for certain amount of time
symptom: User wants a warning mechanism to remind them to change the canula, sensor, or battery after a certain time, because they use less insulin and canula lasts longer than recommended.
fix: The issue was closed as resolved by pull request #3267, which likely added the feature, but the thread does not specify the exact implementation.
evidence_quote: @MilosKozak you can close this issue due to https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/pull/3267
